stages.log:
I was brought into Skyrim under Dominion authority and handed to the garrison at Northwatch Keep with sealed instructions. They held my belongings while the transfer was confirmed.

The confirmation came from Elenwen. By her order I was released and my effects were returned. I was given civilian papers, a little money and a sealed packet. I was not ordered to report to the Embassy, and the garrison was not told what I am.

I should read the packet before I go any further.

Elenwen's instructions are plain. I am not to report to the Embassy. I am to make a life in Skyrim first: work that explains me, somewhere to live, money of my own, and nothing that ties me to her in public.

When that life can stand scrutiny, I am to file an Establishment Report through the dispatch case. The case is to be set down in my lodgings, not carried about.
I have filed the Establishment Report. Elenwen's assessment will come back through the dispatch case after a full day.
Elenwen has accepted my cover and sent the field papers. My service begins in earnest. Orders will come through the dispatch case.

objectives.text: Find work that explains you: a guild, a trade, hunting, paid work or study
File the Establishment Report through the dispatch case
Collect Elenwen's assessment from the dispatch case

documents.title: Sealed Packet
documents.text:
Plain wax. No name on the outside.

Inside: a letter, civilian papers, a purse, instructions for a dispatch case, a blank report form, and the case itself.

documents.title: Letter, Unsigned Seal
documents.text:
You will have noticed that you are not at the Embassy. That is deliberate.

Northwatch has its instructions and nothing more. They know you as a transfer I chose to release. Let them go on knowing that.

You are to make a life in Skyrim. Find work that explains your travel and your questions. Find somewhere to live. Earn money that does not come from me. When that life would satisfy a curious neighbor, complete the enclosed report and file it through the case.

Do not come to the Embassy. Do not use my name to open a door, settle a quarrel or lower a price. If you are asked who you are, you are what your papers say.

This is an assignment, not leave. I will know the difference.

Elenwen

documents.title: Civilian Papers
documents.text:
The bearer, a citizen of Cyrodiil, is permitted to travel within the province of Skyrim and to seek lawful employment there.

Name and description as given by the bearer.
Occupation: none entered.

Countersigned at Northwatch Keep. Released without condition.

documents.title: Instructions for the Dispatch Case
documents.text:
The case is to be set down in your lodgings, not carried about. Set down, it opens into a dispatch box. Pack it before you move.

Filed copies stay with the case. Replies take a full day and are collected from it, not delivered to you.

Until your Establishment Report is accepted, the case will carry that report and nothing else.

documents.title: Establishment Report (Blank)
documents.text:
To be completed when the bearer's civilian position can withstand ordinary scrutiny, and filed through the dispatch case.

Declare:
1. Your occupation, and the work done in it since arrival.
2. Your lodgings.
3. Money earned that was not issued to you.
4. That you have not presented yourself as an officer of the Embassy.

A declaration the facts do not support will not be accepted.

documents.title: Filed Establishment Report: Guild Membership
documents.text:
Establishment Report

Occupation: member of a recognized guild in Skyrim, admitted in the ordinary way.
Lodgings: as declared.
Income: earned since arrival, independent of the allowance.

I have not presented myself as an officer of the Embassy.

Filed by secure dispatch.

documents.title: Filed Establishment Report: Trade or Craft
documents.text:
Establishment Report

Occupation: a trade or craft practised in Skyrim, with goods made and sold since arrival.
Lodgings: as declared.
Income: earned since arrival, independent of the allowance.

I have not presented myself as an officer of the Embassy.

Filed by secure dispatch.

documents.title: Filed Establishment Report: Hunting and Provisioning
documents.text:
Establishment Report

Occupation: hunting and provisioning, with game taken and sold since arrival.
Lodgings: as declared.
Income: earned since arrival, independent of the allowance.

I have not presented myself as an officer of the Embassy.

Filed by secure dispatch.

documents.title: Filed Establishment Report: Paid Work
documents.text:
Establishment Report

Occupation: paid work of the ordinary kind (bounties, escort, errands for hire), with work completed since arrival.
Lodgings: as declared.
Income: earned since arrival, independent of the allowance.

I have not presented myself as an officer of the Embassy.

Filed by secure dispatch.

documents.title: Filed Establishment Report: Study
documents.text:
Establishment Report

Occupation: study and private scholarship, with reading, instruction or spellwork undertaken since arrival.
Lodgings: as declared.
Income: earned since arrival, independent of the allowance.

I have not presented myself as an officer of the Embassy.

Filed by secure dispatch.

documents.title: Assessment: Guild Membership
documents.text:
Accepted. A guild gives you colleagues, and colleagues notice absences. Account for yours before anyone asks. The field papers are enclosed. Orders follow through the case.

Elenwen

documents.title: Assessment: Trade or Craft
documents.text:
Accepted. A trade explains money, travel and an interest in other people's goods. Keep your prices ordinary. The field papers are enclosed. Orders follow through the case.

Elenwen

documents.title: Assessment: Hunting and Provisioning
documents.text:
Accepted. Hunters go where they like and are asked very little. Do not mistake that for an ambition. The field papers are enclosed. Orders follow through the case.

Elenwen

documents.title: Assessment: Paid Work
documents.text:
Accepted. Paid work explains your arms and your travel, and it puts you among people who talk. Keep it from putting you in front of a magistrate. The field papers are enclosed. Orders follow through the case.

Elenwen

documents.title: Assessment: Study
documents.text:
Accepted. A scholar may ask almost any question, provided it concerns the past. Use that. The field papers are enclosed. Orders follow through the case.

Elenwen
